SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS name, P.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, P.PRICE AS price, P.STOCK_QUANTITY AS stockQuantity, P.DESCRIPTION AS description, P.STATUS AS status, P.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WISHLIST W WHERE W.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID AND W.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}) AS wished
FROM PRODUCT P
AND P.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_ID DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT P.PRODUCT_ID AS productId, P.CATEGORY_ID AS categoryId, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS name, P.BRAND_NAME AS brandName, P.PRICE AS price, P.STOCK_QUANTITY AS stockQuantity, P.DESCRIPTION AS description, P.STATUS AS status, P.IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, P.VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount,
PR.PROMOTION_ID AS "promotion.promotionId", PR.PROMOTION_TITLE AS "promotion.promotionTitle", PR.DISCOUNT_TYPE AS "promotion.discountType", PR.DISCOUNT_VALUE AS "promotion.discountValue", PR.MIN_ORDER_AMOUNT AS "promotion.minOrderAmount", PR.STATUS AS "promotion.status" FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PROMOTION_PRODUCT PP ON P.PRODUCT_ID = PP.PRODUCT_ID LEFT JOIN PROMOTION PR ON PP.PROMOTION_ID = PR.PROMOTION_ID WHERE P.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId} ORDER BY PR.PROMOTION_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, BRAND_NAME AS brandName, PRICE AS price, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, VIEW_COUNT AS viewCount FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY VIEW_COUNT DESC, PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT PRODUCT_ID AS productId, PRODUCT_NAME AS name, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, PRICE AS price, BRAND_NAME AS brandName, CREATED_AT AS createdAt FROM PRODUCT ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC, PRODUCT_ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
